_doc: Ledger 0054 P0 (2026-10-14): the expansion research (session scratchpad expansion/, research run 2026-10-12/13, read-only on the repo, the workshop and the AC folder) is temporary; the parts the build reads are copied here unchanged, with where each came from and its sha256. EXPANSION-PLAN.md 'Research' row and P0.

routes__routes_analysis.json.what: routes lens: fresh OSM (2026-10-12T18:03Z, overpass-api.de, TLS verified) - both directions J1..J5, legs, way lists, one-way-aware paths, controls, junction bearings. Source of data/route.north.spec.json (P0 step 4).

routes__mouths.json.what: routes lens: every side street / driveway mouth along the north legs (A1: curb runs straight past).

routes__legs.geojson.what: routes lens: the legs as GeoJSON (both directions).

routes__profile_3dep.json.what: routes lens: 3DEP profile along the legs (stations from each junction node).

aerial__widths_eye.csv.what: aerial lens: curb-to-curb widths and medians read by eye at 30 stations on NAIP 2022-04-25 0.6 m (0.3 m zooms, 10 m grid); EXPANSION-PLAN A3 / V1. P1 interpolates the per-station curb offsets from it.

aerial__veg_bins.json.what: aerial lens: vegetation zones along the legs (A9).

revise__measure.json.what: revise pass: node-to-node 3DEP 1 m profiles, junction heights J1..J5, the Mission Gorge crest, max grades (A6 / V2).

revise__mouth_sides.py.what: revise pass: how the J1 / J5 openings on the loop's outer curb were measured (A5) - kept as the method of record.

revise__clamp_options.py.what: revise pass: the clamp re-simulation behind D3 (settled by the global 20 / 40 in v0.18.0).

pipeline__mouth_geometry.json.what: pipeline lens: the J1 / J5 mouth geometry against the race boxes (A5 / A7).

pipeline__osm_lamps_signals.json.what: pipeline lens: OSM street lamps and signals near the new roads (D4, A8).

terrain__out__views.json.what: terrain lens: sightlines from the new roads (V7 stations: Cowles, Kwaay Paay, Pyles).

terrain__out__los_fine.json.what: terrain lens: fine line-of-sight checks behind V7.
